source.title: The Way of the Hunter
source.description: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident hunter trainer--Tai'ree Farsight--left this note for you. You can find her just over yonder near the center of the village. Read the note then seek her out.
source.objective: Read the Scribbled Note and then speak with Tai'ree Farsight in Thendal Grove.
